observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor provides cultural context and encouragement before demonstrating each step clearly. She breaks down the footwork at different angles and speeds, highlighting common errors to avoid.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction to old style jingle dance and channel background.
Recommendation of historical resources and discussion of arm positions.
Overview of the three footwork variations to be taught.
Breakdown and slow practice of the basic 1-2 step.
Close-up demonstration of the basic 1-2 step.
Explanation and demonstration of the 1-2 shuffle step.
Close-up practice of the shuffle step.
Explanation of the teacher's personal 1-2-3 switch step variation.
Close-up practice of the switch step variation.
Explanation and demonstration of the side step.
Close-up practice of the side step.

safety: Most of the song you are up on your calves
Raising is coming straight from my calf muscles

steps_taught.name: Basic step
steps_taught.description: A alternating weight tap matching a basic one-two step rhythm.

steps_taught.name: Shuffle step
steps_taught.description: Basic steps interspersed with a shuffle switch between feet.

steps_taught.name: Switch step
steps_taught.description: Lifting heels up and down at alternating times with a hop on three.

steps_taught.name: Side step
steps_taught.description: Stepping side to side while staying elevated on the calves.

what_works: Switching between wide view and close-up footwork angles
Clear verbal descriptions paired with slow demonstrations
what_hinders: Lacks counting counts out loud consistently during full tempo demos

quotes.text: In this video, I am going to teach you how to dance old style jingle.
When you're dancing old style jingle, there are two places you can hold your hands.
If you're going to dance old style jingle, you're not going backwards.
It just looks like you're floating across the floor.

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher stands facing front demonstrating two alternate arm placements.
Teacher steps in place shifting body weight between feet.
Close-up on footwear showing alternate stepping motion.
Close-up on feet executing shuffle footwork.

extraction.distinctive_method: Emphasizing traditional restrictions by explicitly listing what not to do compared to contemporary styles (no spinning, no going backward).
